SELECT product_sku, title, brand, category,
       price_amount, currency, stock_status, promo_text,
       image_url, attributes::text AS attributes_text
  FROM tecbite_product_state
 WHERE is_active = true
   AND attributes::text ILIKE $1
   AND attributes::text ILIKE $2
   AND (
     ($3 = 'kit' AND (title ILIKE '%Kit%' OR title ILIKE '%Fix Point%' OR title ILIKE '%Fixpoint%' OR title ILIKE '%Clamp%' OR title ILIKE '%Flush%'))
     OR ($3 = 'feet' AND (title ILIKE '%Foot%' OR title ILIKE '%Gutter%' OR title ILIKE '%pie%'))
   )
 ORDER BY
   CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%Kit%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
   CASE stock_status WHEN 'in_stock' THEN 1 WHEN 'out_of_stock' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
   price_amount ASC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 80;

SELECT product_sku, title, brand, category, price_amount, currency, stock_status, promo_text, image_url
  FROM tecbite_product_state
 WHERE is_active = true
   AND product_sku = ANY($1::text[])
 ORDER BY CASE stock_status WHEN 'in_stock' THEN 1 WHEN 'out_of_stock' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
